title: Penne Alla Vodka
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package directions.
Melt the butter and olive oil together in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onions, garlic, and red pepper flakes. Cook until the onion is translucent, about 7 to 10 minutes.
Add the vodka and allow the alcohol to cook out, about 15 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the heavy cream and stir to combine. Don't allow the sauce to become too hot or the cream could break or curdle.
Bring the sauce to a simmer again and remove from heat.
Combine the sauce with the noodles and toss to coat.
Top with grated parmesan and serve immediately. Enjoy!

tips.title: Keep the heat gentle after the cream goes in
tips.text: If the sauce gets too hot once the cream is added, it can break or curdle — simmer briefly, then take it off the heat.

notes: From the wedding cookbook. The basil is optional in the source ('Can add basil also — ask mommy how much'). The photo on the submitted page is a family snapshot, not the dish, so the banner photo is a web photo of penne alla vodka.
